bt.copied: Note in the BioTransformer help window: the SMILES of the drawing was copied to the clipboard; {smiles} = SMILES (abbreviated).
load.err.worker: Error of the computation process in the browser, on the waiting screen; {text} = technical text (English).
load.demo.job: Title of the progress panel while the example files are downloading.
load.demo.mb: Numbers of the examples progress panel; {mb} = megabytes already downloaded with one decimal.
load.exp.nameHint: Notice in a file's row when the name suggests an experiment different from the one in the file; {hint} and {kind} = experiment names (Full Scan, MS2 (Product Ion), MRM, or «no data»).
load.exp.precursors: In parentheses, in the Experiment column of a mixed file: number of MS2 precursors.
load.recipe.raw: Notice when a .raw file is dragged in; {name} = file name (already protected). The text contains commands: «folder» is the folder name.
load.recipe.wiff: Notice when a .wiff file is dragged in; {name} = file name. The title in quotes refers to the box «Do you have .wiff files...» (load.wiff.summary).
load.recipe.wiffScan: Notice when a .wiff.scan file is dragged in; {name} = file name.
load.recipe.d: Notice when a .d file is dragged in; {name} = name.
load.loaded.title: Title of the box when more files are added to an open session; {n} = number of files.
settings.space.value: Gear menu line (site only); {files} and {idx} = sizes already written, e.g. «31.9 MB».
ctl.map.diff: Label of the map menu; {select} = the file drop-down menu (HTML).
map.height3d: Text on the 3D map; {scale} = color scale.
map.leg3d.scale: After the 3D legend; {scale} = sqrt/linear/log, {norm} = normalization or empty.
ctl.prec.n: Entry of the precursors menu of the product-ion spectrum; {v} = precursor m/z, {n} = number of scans.
ctl.chip.sub: Label next to the Correction menu; {label} = name of the subtracted sample.
ctx.spec.formulas: Right-click menu on a high-resolution peak; {mz} = m/z. The program proposes candidates, it does not identify.
spec.scanLine.prec: Line above the spectrum: isolated precursor; {prec} = precursor m/z.
tbl.add.divided: Tail of the expression of a multiply charged adduct (e.g. «M + 2.0146, divided by 2»); {z} = charge.
hr.pol.tip: Tooltip on the polarity sign; {pol} = positive / negative / mixed (as written in the file).
lib.dirNone: Message after «Reload from the folder» when there are no new libraries; {name} = folder name.
bn.dec.n: Entry of the decimals menu; {n} = number of decimals.
bn.pks.done: Message after «Integrate in all cells»; {t} = peak time in minutes, {n} = traces integrated.
conv.profile: Checkbox under the loading area (only where the engine converts .raw and .wiff): ticked = mzML with profile data, unticked = centroids.
conv.profile.title: Hover explanation of the profile checkbox.
conv.profile.note: Note under the profile checkbox in the loading screen: says which formats it applies to.
load.loaded.clearSure: Confirmation of the «Clear loaded data» button of the already-loaded files tab; {n} = how many files.
tpmine.centroided: Tabui notice when a profile file is centroided at load. {name} = file name.
tpmine.feat.degraded: Tabui (pipeline) notice when memory is not enough for the evidence: the table is saved without evidence. {files} = number of files, {phase} = rejected phase, {stima_mb} = estimated memory in MB, {budget_mb} = budget in MB.
bn.idn.loaded: Outcome of loading files or a folder; {n} = libraries loaded, {m} = files ignored.
canali.tip.time: Line of a channel's tooltip with its time interval; {a} and {b} = start and end time in minutes.
meta.versionUnverified: Entry of method/1.warnings: format version not verified, read with the closest layout. {place} = version, text from the reader.
